verdict.rationale: MotherDuck is a serverless data warehouse built on DuckDB that runs SQL against your databases (probe-1, docs-12). Community praise for Instant SQL's CTE inspection (comm-7) shows CTE queries are supported. Nothing in the pack documents the rest of the analytical SQL surface, or that it works without extensions. Missing for 10: evidence of window functions, semi-structured JSON support, array types, rich date/time types, confirmation that these are built in rather than extensions, and first-party SQL reference documentation.
